sources: Not documented on Microsoft Learn; the value matches the 'Widgets' switch (Settings > Personalization > Taskbar). On newer builds Windows can block other programs from writing this value; the tweak then reports an error and changes nothing. The host test checks the registry behavior; whether the display changes as described still needs a visual check, therefore 'Disputed' until then.

Host test 2026-10-18 on build 26200: Windows denies write access (protection driver for user settings); the tweak was rolled back cleanly. Therefore only up to build 22631; on newer builds DEB-027 (documented policy) turns off widgets.
